note: Which layers a new venture starts with, by phase (EE-012). Every venture has every layer; a layer not listed starts as false and is switched on when the venture needs it. Folder names are the layer names. Every venture also gets the three pillars and a venture profile (EE-010, EE-011). Governance is added when the venture is formalized: a legal form other than none, or other members.

readme.purpose: Why this venture exists: its core product, products and the Product Anatomy matrix.
readme.knowledge: What is known and intended: notes, specs, decisions and references (SAD).
readme.operations: How work is run here: the MAD record (.mad/) and chosen methods.
readme.execution: Who or what does the work: handoffs to people and agents.
readme.evidence: Did it work: reviews, evals and metrics.
readme.governance: Who may decide what: roles and decision rights.
readme.interface: How people and agents see this venture: consoles and dashboards.
